universe.primary: the 116 B5 keystone_full pools selected by the pre-W1 learner and frozen friction gate
universe.baseline: all 431 W1-W3 opportunities under the same execution estimator; missing legacy exit trigger falls back to entry_block+7200

entry.implementation_anchor: existing frozen entry_block, which represents the KEYSTONE t0+10m decision point
entry.fill: first decoded real buy at or after entry_block with WETH amount >=0.001 and no later than entry_block+900 blocks
entry.no_fill: flat return 0; no fictitious loss and no gas

exit.scheduled_blocks: legacy_exb + delay_minutes*30; if legacy_exb missing, entry_block+7200 + delay_minutes*30
exit.tier_1_real_fill: first decoded real sell at or after scheduled block and within 60 blocks whose target-token amount is >= the 0.001-WETH entry quantity; use raw amount average price
exit.tier_2_atomic: if tier 1 absent, pinned same-block AtomicRoundTrip; use recovered_weth/received_target as executable unit price for historical entry quantity, then multiply proceeds by 0.90
exit.observation_cutoff_source: maximum locally decoded Base V3 swap block measured before B8 result computation
exit.late_recovery: if atomic is a known failure but a later decoded real sell before the fixed observation cutoff has target-token amount >= position quantity, use the first such real price and charge one extra failed-exit gas leg
exit.true_rug: known atomic failure and zero later decoded real sells of any size through the fixed observation cutoff; only this state receives -100% gross plus attempted gas
exit.subcapacity_or_rpc_unknown: UNRESOLVED, never imputed to -100%; any primary unresolved row prevents PASS

cost.real_fill_fee_and_impact: included in decoded raw average price
cost.atomic_fee_and_impact: included in AtomicRoundTrip recovered amount before the additional 10% haircut

capacity.method: QuoterV2 token-to-WETH quotes at the primary 30m scheduled block for 1x, 3x and 10x the historical entry quantity; diagnostic only and never used as B8 return

helper_address_risk.selection: smallest sha256('B8-holder|'+pool) among entered primary rows
helper_address_risk.test: from entry receipt Transfer logs identify the actual token recipient; at the pinned entry block check balanceOf and eth_call transfer(pool, min(balance, position_qty)) from that recipient
helper_address_risk.interpretation: tests address-specific token transfer restriction only; it does not prove router approval or a historical wallet swap fill

derived_regime_gate.input: causal trailing-7d honeypot_proxy_rate from corrected B6 weather data; no W1/W2/W3 label is an input
derived_regime_gate.threshold: 35th percentile (linear quantile) of eligible pre-2026-04-15 calibration days
derived_regime_gate.evaluation: heldout OOS only; compare ungated, derived gate, and 10000 random calendar-day gates with the identical OOS open-day count

monte_carlo.resampling: stratified by regime from primary 30m ungated returns

right_tail.applies_to: primary 30m ungated honest estimator; gate is an incremental OOS test, not a rescue prerequisite
right_tail.decision: all true => PASS evidence status; any tested false => FAIL; n<20 is descriptive; unresolved => INCONCLUSIVE; never a GO decision

forbidden: B7 post-hoc +57.67% cannot satisfy any B8 pass gate
QuoterV2 cannot be used as primary realized return
missing evidence cannot be converted to -100%
no send, sign, broadcast, live configuration change, executor or strategy start/restart
